name: Zhejiang Leapmotor Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Leapmotor Technology Co., Ltd., a company primarily operating within the People's Republic of China, focuses on the innovation, production, and distribution of new energy vehicles. Its diverse lineup of intelligent electric vehicles features the C01 sedan, the C11 mid-size SUV, the compact T03, and the S01 coupe. Beyond manufacturing automobiles, Leapmotor also provides electronic components for smart EVs, operates electric vehicle charging services, runs car rental activities, and offers comprehensive technical and after-sales support. The enterprise was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
